descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT 3.5; TFA-94745 AC 2 · “the app retries, then switches to the backup model or shows a clear message”. Mixed: stated part — (a) a failed photo read and (b) a failed extraction retry or fall back, or show a clear message, and nothing pasted is lost; our part — Announcing the error to assistive technology, axe, labels, tap size and phone layout of the error states (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Bug B17 · S1 · new

Errors show the raw server message to the physician ('[CONVEX A(ai/vision:scanPriorNote)] … Server Error … 404')

Tickets: TFA-94745 ready for qa; TFA-94425 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local

Note: Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-94423): counted on TC-13/S28 (the physician sees the raw error, TFA-94745). The provider text a vision failure forwards to the browser (OAT-05/S30) is now suggestion A6. Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-94745): a failed dictation recovery shows the raw Convex error too (usePreRoundAudioRecovery.ts:227, useAudioBackup.ts:95; OAT-03/S19, TC-23/S25).

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-03/S19

Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S28 When the AI fails: photo read error, extraction primary-model failure, and the panel's non-default states on desktop and phone

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U15 When a photo read or an extraction fails or is slow, the app retries and then switches to the backup model or shows a clear message that is announced to assistive technology. … (UAT 3.5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress
  • U1 Paste and photograph are physician-triggered only. Nothing is read, extracted or written to the chart until the physician pastes or photographs a prior note and saves it, and no prior note is pulled … (UAT TC-13; TFA-92591 AC 6; TFA-92591 How it works 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Hospital and Nursing Home Pre-Round. ai/vision:scanPriorNote is mocked to fail (like dev's Vertex 404 before PR #102), and on the local stack the primary extraction model is forced to fail

When (a) Photograph → the read fails. (b) Paste → Save & Extract while the primary model fails. (c) Run axe and the phone checks (pixel7, iphone15) with the Paste form open, a saved note expanded, and the photo error shown

Then (a) A clear error appears and is announced (role=alert or a live region). The button leaves 'Reading', nothing is saved, Paste still works and Photograph can be retried. (b) aiCallLog shows a fallback row (Mistral Large 3) and the fields fill without a tap; or, once retries are exhausted, a clear message appears and the pasted note is kept. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 3.5 ('retries, then switches to the backup model or shows a clear message; never left waiting with nothing') + 3.9 + WCAG 2 A/AA (axe-core violations = 0, visual-checks.ts). On main the photo error line has no role=alert (the extraction error line has one), so a finding is expected

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method FAULT · Fault injection; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (blocked)

S28 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-13.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: New product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92591 ready for qa; TFA-94745 ready for qa

When a prior-note photo read fails on the server, the physician sees raw server text ('[CONVEX A(ai/vision:scanPriorNote)] [Request ID: …] Server Error … Vertex AI request failed: 404'), and the error is not announced to a screen reader.

Evidence: allure 38253418. (a) The error shows, nothing is saved, and Paste and retry work, but there is no role=alert and a thrown read shows the raw text. (b) Extraction falls back from Haiku x2 to Mistral and fills the fields (pass). (c) Accessibility: low-contrast heading, date and note fields labelled only by placeholder, and on phones the 'Note · <date>' toggle is 276×16 px and the delete button 21×21 px. The raw text breaks TFA-94745 AC 2 / EFS U12 (ungated; EFS S19 not built) and is not in the dev report, the ledger or any knownGaps. The gate for U15 is TFA-92591 (in progress). Observation: a photo read after a saved paste appends to the old paste text.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: FAULT · Fault injection; secondary: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.
